basic_details.job_title: Burari Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Burari Hospital (Govt. of NCT of Delhi) is holding a walk-in interview for 05 Senior Resident posts in Pediatrics on every Friday from 20/11/2026 to 11/12/2026. Candidates must report between 9 AM and 11 AM at the Office of the Medical Director, Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Delhi - 110084; entry is allowed up to 11 AM. The posts are ad-hoc for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins, with pay as per 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi.

age_limit.details: The age limit is a maximum of 45 years as on the date of interview, as per order no. F.No.DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy(H&FW)CDno#11245060/1502-008 dated 26-11-2020. Age is relaxable up to 05 years for SC and ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates (Non Creamy Layer belonging to Delhi only).

content_sections.heading: About Burari Hospital
content_sections.text: Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Delhi, is a hospital of the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. The notice says it began as a dedicated COVID hospital in 2020 and started general non-Covid services in 2022. It is described as a 768 bedded hospital with a 50 bedded ICU, state of the art OT and laboratories, and its own dedicated oxygen supply, serving an urban and rural population of approximately 10 lakhs.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites Senior Residents on ad-hoc basis for 05 vacant posts in Pediatrics. The vacancies are provisional and subject to change without any notice. They are shown category-wise below and add up to 05. Seats are reserved for SC, ST, OBC (Delhi NCL) and differently abled candidates as per prevailing Govt. Rules. If reserved category candidates are not available, candidates from other categories may be considered on ad-hoc basis for 44 days. MBBS with post graduate degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per Residency Scheme in the concerned specialty from a recognized University/Institute on the day of interview. If an MD/DNB certificate is not available, candidates who have 02 years experience in the concerned department will be considered for the post on ad-hoc basis. The candidate must be registered (with MBBS and requisite postgraduate qualification) with Delhi Medical Council on or before the day of interview, and should have a valid DMC certificate or have applied for receipt of the PG Degree/Diploma DMC on the date of interview. The candidate must not have completed 03 years as Senior Resident in any recognized institute, including regular or ad-hoc. The age limit is a maximum of 45 years as on the date of interview, as per order no. F.No.DHF&W/Q015/57/2016-HR-Medical-Secy(H&FW)CDno#11245060/1502-008 dated 26-11-2020. Age is relaxable up to 05 years for SC and ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates (Non Creamy Layer belonging to Delhi only). Candidates who have already done one SR Residency in any Govt./Govt. aided institution for three years will also be considered under relaxed norms if fresh candidates are not available. They are selected under the relaxed eligibility criteria in circular No F.No 212/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10.06.2011 of Health and Family Welfare, Delhi Govt. A separate list is prepared for fresh candidates and for candidates shortlisted under relaxed criteria, and those selected under relaxed criteria are appointed on ad-hoc basis for 44 days. OBC candidates belonging to Delhi (Non creamy layer) will be considered for an OBC seat. They should have a Delhi OBC (Non creamy) certificate issued in the current financial year. If a candidate applies under OBC but cannot provide valid proof at document verification before the interview, the candidature is rejected and the candidate is not allowed for interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: Pay shall be in accordance with 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi. The notice does not print a rupee amount. Appointment and services are governed under the Residency Scheme. The appointment is initially for 44 days or till a regular candidate joins, extendable up to a maximum of three years on the basis of satisfactory work and conduct report from the concerned HOD and a written request from the SR concerned. The total tenure of a Senior Resident will be a maximum of three years, which also includes any senior residency tenure done in another govt./govt. funded institution. The contract can be terminated by either party by giving a notice of one month without assigning any reason. All appointments are subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates of educational qualification, age, caste and submission of a valid DMC post-graduation registration certificate.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is purely as per a merit list based on the walk-in interview. Candidates report at the office of the Medical Director on the day of interview between 9 AM and 11 AM for verification of documents with originals. A panel of wait listed candidates will be prepared for filling the post of SR for vacancies arising in future. The panel remains valid for 6 months or till a fresh selection process is carried out, whichever is earlier. If a holiday is declared on a scheduled date, the schedule shifts to the next working day or as decided by the Medical Director. The decision of the Selection Board/Medical Director regarding selection is final and binding, and no representation will be entertained. The result is displayed on the website of the Delhi Government and on the notice board. No letter or personal information is issued. A candidate who accepts the offer must join within the stipulated time mentioned in the offer of appointment, and shortlisted candidates must also get their documents verified in the hospital on the day of joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Fill the application form through the Google Forms link given in the notice (https://forms.gle/QuXk2g2MJzTiYHM79) or by scanning the QR code printed in the notice. The link can be opened on a computer or on a smart device such as a phone or tablet. After submitting, an auto generated email is sent. If it is not received, check the trash or spam folder. The auto generated mail contains a prefilled application form based on the data submitted by the candidate. Bring a printout of this form on the day of interview along with a photocopy and the originals of all documents. Report at the Office of the Medical Director, Burari Hospital, Kaushik Enclave, Delhi - 110084 between 9.00 AM and 11.00 AM on the scheduled interview date.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Documents are required in original along with self attested photocopies, in the given order: X class certificate (for Date of Birth) Attempt Certificate Degree (MBBS and Post graduate degree/DNB or Diploma) Experience certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card/Voter ID/Passport Publications (indexed journal only) Two passport size photos and the printout of the prefilled application form

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is paid for participating in the selection process. If any declaration or information is found false or willfully suppressed, the candidature or appointment is cancelled forthwith and administrative or legal action is taken. Delhi Medical Council will also be intimated for initiating appropriate action. Candidature is rejected if any discrepancy is detected in a document or information at any stage of recruitment. Candidates are to follow all rules of social distancing and wear a mask. Queries and clarifications may be posted on [email protected] .
